skills.name: autopilot
skills.description: Plan a task through conversation into plan.md, then keep the agent from stopping via a Stop hook until every Done When criterion and every todo is checked.
skills.short_description: Plan into plan.md, then use a Stop hook to keep the agent going until every checkbox is ticked.
skills.default_prompt: Use $autopilot in Codex to talk through the task into plan.md (goal, scope, done-when, detailed todos). For every selection-type question, always ask with exactly `1.`, `2.`, `3.`, `4. 기타`, and if the user picks `4`, immediately ask for a short free-form reply. When you show a plan or choice list, make that block the last visible content of the turn so the user can read it before Codex collapses the reply. After saving an approved plan, stop with a short confirmation and wait for a separate explicit `진행`/`continue` message before starting execution. When execution starts, a Stop hook checks plan.md each time the agent tries to stop and forces it to continue as long as unchecked items remain.

skills.name: webp
skills.description: Use demoon84/webp-maker to convert image files to WebP or build animated WebP assets from folders of frames.
skills.short_description: Run webp-maker to create static or animated WebP assets.
skills.default_prompt: Use $webp to run demoon84/webp-maker for WebP conversion, animated WebP generation, or full pipeline processing.
